item.description:
Saturday, August 15, 2026 at 9 AM

Location: The Lighthouse of Houston, 3602 West Dallas, Houston, TX, 77019, United States

Join us at The Lighthouse of Houston on August 15 from 9:00 AM to 12:30 PM for our 2026 Transition and Resource Fair—a dynamic, hands-on event designed for blind and visually impaired youth ages 14–22. This exciting fair empowers students with essential life skills including self-advocacy, confidence building, job readiness, and computer literacy. Attendees will explore adaptive technology, orientation and mobility training, and even get creative with accessible arts and crafts. The event also features a wide range of community and government resources—all at no cost. Plus, students will receive free BVI accessible school supplies and a backpack! item.description:
Wednesday, September 30, 2026 at 12 PM

The Lighthouse will be hosting a weekly Braille Club to help people learn functional Braille skills in a friendly group setting. The club meets every Wednesday from 12:00 PM to 2:00 PM. We will use fun games and activities to help everyone gain useful skills for daily life. Members will learn how to read playing cards for games, label items around their homes, and read signs and elevator buttons in public places. To join the club, participants need access to email and a notebook to keep their handout papers organized. Because the group learns new things every week, it is highly recommended to attend each session so you do not miss out on any important tips. REGISTER HERE.
